shortDescription: Weapon mounts that fire an ordinary ranged weapon item from a fixed position with more range. Manned mounts use the gunner's shooting skill, aim speed and traits, and give cover. With Biotech, automated mounts run on mech subcores or an AI persona core.
body:
# Mounted Weapons (v1 built and tested in-game; DMS compatibility tested in runs #37-#38)

## What's in the mod
A mount is a turret (`MountedWeapons.Building_WeaponMount`, subclass of Building_TurretGun) that fires a real weapon item the player installs. Quality, art, HP, biocode state and comps stay with the item.

### Manned line (always loaded)
| Def | Research | Range | Stability | Aim time | Cover (fillPercent) | Art / material |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| MW_WeaponMount | MW_WeaponMounts (Smithing) | 115% | 0.20 | 100% | 0.40 | MW_WeaponMount single texture |
| MW_WeaponMountReinforced | MW_ReinforcedMounts (+Machining) | 125% | 0.35 | 90% | 0.55 | sandbag-linked atlas (links with Sandbags), Leathery/Fabric stuff + Steel 50; cloth tinted (139,122,87) like vanilla sandbags |
| MW_GunEmplacement | MW_ArmoredEmplacements (+Microelectronics) | 135% | 0.50 | 80% | 0.75 | barricade-linked atlas (links with Barricades), Stony/Metallic stuff + Steel 50, Plasteel 50, 4 components; draws a gun shield |
Stability = fraction of the gunner's per-cell miss chance removed. Gunner stands one cell behind. Linked defs need uiIconPath for the placement ghost; blueprints reuse vanilla Sandbags/Barricade blueprint atlases. Linked art doesn't show facing; the arc overlay does.

### Gun shield
Purely visual, code-drawn. MountExtension shieldTexPath / shieldDrawSize / shieldOffset (cells forward along the aim). Building_WeaponMount.DrawShield draws the plate after the weapon, at the pivot plus the offset rotated to the aim angle, flipped mesh for aim 200-340. Only defs with shieldTexPath draw it (emplacement: MW_GunShield, 1.1x1.1, offset 0.25). Recoil not applied to it.

### Automated line (Biotech folder via LoadFolders IfModActive)
| Def | Core | Extra research | ShootingAccuracyTurret | Range | Aim | Force-target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| MW_AutoMountBasic | SubcoreBasic | - | 0.95 | 120% | 100% | no |
| MW_AutoMountStandard | SubcoreRegular | StandardMechtech | 0.97 | 125% | 90% | no |
| MW_AutoMountHigh | SubcoreHigh | HighMechtech | 0.98 | 130% | 80% | yes |
| MW_AutoMountPersona | AIPersonaCore | HighMechtech | 0.987 | 135% | 70% | yes |
Art: user's mortar-base textures, drawSize 1.3.

### Firing arc
Cone centred on the building's facing (Rot4.AsAngle). Settings: manned default 120°, automated default 360° (unlimited). Enforced in TryFindNewTarget, OrderAttack (MW_TargetOutsideArc), Fire, and Tick (forced target reset; TurretTop rotation clamped). Shown as a field-edge overlay when selected and while placing (PlaceWorker_FiringArc).

### Weapon drawing
PawnRenderUtility.DrawEquipmentAiming, with optional alpha-weighted centroid centring (WeaponArtCentroid, cached per texture) so the art's visual mass sits over the pivot.

### Weapon lifecycle
- "Choose weapon" float menu; weapons chosen by another mount are listed last, greyed out.
- WorkGiver MW_InstallMountedWeapon (Hauling) carries and installs (180 ticks).
- Remove gizmo; destroyed mount drops the weapon with random damage up to the setting.
- Mountable = ranged primary with CompEquippable, not destroyOnDrop, not TurretGun tag, not grenade, not one-use, not biocoded, and the primary verb is a Verb_LaunchProjectile, a Verb_ShootBeam, or a Verb_Spray with a defaultProjectile. The spray case covers Dead Man's Switch gatlings (Fortified.Verb_ArcSprayProjectile: M214, GAU-19, GAU-4, GAU-8). Spray guns hit a fixed swept path, so stability and gunner skill don't change their hits; consumeFuelPerBurst does nothing on a mount (no CompRefuelable).

### Core refund
Core in costList + leavingsBlacklist. Deconstruct always returns it; killed: lost at the settings chance (default 50%).

### Settings (Entad/Titan-style tabs)
General / Manned mounts / Automated mounts. XML values are defaults; only changed entries are saved. Mockup: .circinus/mockups/settings-window.html.

## Harmony patches
- Postfix ShotReport.HitFactorFromShooter: manned mount uses gunner ShootingAccuracyPawn + stability.
- Prefix Projectile.Launch (8-arg): swap building for the mounted weapon as equipment.

## Known limits
- No arc re-check mid-burst; mortars use non-mortar targeting; minified mount destroyed while packed loses its contents; CE unsupported.
- Old saves: emplacements built before they took stuff log one "made from stuff but has no stuff set" error each on load and become steel.
